MACRO.WHAT: NOH is strengthening; RAM is not yet directionally called.
MACRO.WHY: NOH trades at 77¢ against its 74¢ opening anchor; RAM trades at 25¢ against its 26¢ opening anchor; these are observed directions, not proof of the next move.
MACRO.HOW: NOH carries 106 eligible past sides from first-price comparisons; RAM carries 417 eligible past sides from first-price comparisons, passing weighted possible futures to MICRO.

MICRO.WHAT: NOH calls 77¢ by T−0hr 30min; RAM calls 25¢ by T−0hr 30min.
MICRO.WHY: NOH’s middle half spans 75–77¢; RAM’s middle half spans 25–25¢; the call is the weighted middle of translated member futures, not a closing-price forecast.
